key_provisions_or_claims: Sets the EU position in the EEA Joint Committee on incorporating Regulation (EU) 2022/123 into the EEA Agreement.
EFTA States fully associated with the Executive Steering Group on Shortages and Safety of Medicinal Products, without voting rights.
EFTA States fully associated with the Emergency Task Force and the Executive Steering Group on Shortages of Medical Devices.
Annex II and Protocol 37 of the EEA Agreement are amended; Article 34(2) is adapted to refer to Article 53 EEA.
Decision enters into force on adoption (25 June 2024).
annotation.summary_en: Council Decision (EU) 2024/1844 fixes the EU position in the EEA Joint Committee for incorporating Regulation (EU) 2022/123, on the European Medicines Agency's reinforced role in crisis preparedness for medicines and medical devices, into the EEA Agreement. It associates EFTA States with the relevant steering groups and task force, without voting rights.
annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (EU) 2024/1844 of 25 June 2024 on the position to be adopted, on behalf of the European Union, within the EEA Joint Committee concerning the amendment of Annex II and Protocol 37 to the EEA Agreement (Reinforced role for EMA in crisis preparedness and management for medicinal products and medical devices)
